verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an authenticator product, but the evidence documents only mobile-app interactions such as swiping, QR scanning and account sync. The GitHub items mention OTP implementations and a PAM module, neither of which is shown to be an official command-line interface. Community reports of reading the sqlite database on a rooted phone are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
